mainSoftware.Description:
victor Professional Software License, includes: victor Application Server, 1 concurrent victor Unified Client connection, 1 concurrent victor Web client connection & 1 concurrent victor Go client connection (Base). Includes software application plus Microsoft SQL Express Edition database engine. From version 5.4 mapping, health monitoring and Record on Surveillance is included as standard. In an installation of less than 100 cameras, victor site manager and victor unified client can run on the same workstation.
